# Name mobile content disclosures and announce their state

## Context

Mobile navigation is part of the Learning polish for Engine 14 and the owning epic #20498. The disclosure controls need a name and a state screen readers can announce.

## The Problem

On `dev` `3f01b65ae4`, Chromium at 390 × 844 shows the Topics and On this page controls as unnamed buttons. Their `aria-expanded` attribute is absent before keyboard activation, while open, and after selecting a row. Enter opens each panel and a selection closes it. The visual state changes throughout.

## The Architectural Reality

`src/app/content/Container.mjs` creates the Topics control and `src/app/content/SectionsContainer.mjs` creates On this page. Both disclosures use the panel’s `neo-expanded` class for visibility. Portal Learn and News Releases use these classes. Learn closes Topics through article selection and SectionsContainer closes On this page after a section selection.

Design authority: [WAI-ARIA disclosure pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/disclosure/) specifies true while visible and false while hidden, with native Enter and Space activation.

## The Fix

Name each icon-only button through the existing `Button.ariaLabel` config. Project the owning panel’s open class to the button’s `aria-expanded` attribute on its initial render and subsequent class changes. Use the same projection for direct and implicit closure.

## Contract Ledger

| Surface | Authority | Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Topics and On this page button names and expanded state | Shared content panels and the disclosure pattern | Button names describe their content. `aria-expanded` tracks visible disclosure state through all existing paths. | A closed panel announces `false`. | WAI-ARIA disclosure pattern | Chromium accessibility trees plus keyboard and selection checks |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Both mobile Learn buttons have distinct accessible names and expose `aria-expanded` false before opening, true after Enter or Space, and false after closing.
- [ ] Selecting an article or a heading closes its respective panel and announces the closed state.
- [ ] Verify the same name and state behavior in News Releases, a second consumer of the shared widgets.

## Out of Scope

Layout redesign and the Learning article-anchor navigation owned by #22027.
